recipes.title: Spicy Red Lentil & Spinach Dahl
recipes.ingredients:
500g red lentils
400g dry brown rice
3 large onions
1 head of garlic
1 bag fresh spinach
2 cans diced tomatoes
2 tbsp rapeseed oil
Curry powder, turmeric, cumin, chili flakes
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook the brown rice and set aside.
2. Sauté diced onions and minced garlic in oil until soft.
3. Stir in 3 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp turmeric, and chili flakes.
4. Add rinsed lentils, tomatoes, and 1.5L water.
5. Simmer 25-30 mins until thickened.
6. Stir in spinach at the end. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Lazy Gołąbki Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
400g roasted buckwheat
3 cans white beans
1 head white cabbage
3 onions
500g mushrooms
3 cartons tomato passata
2 tbsp rapeseed oil
Marjoram, garlic powder
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook buckwheat until tender. Drain beans.
2. Chop cabbage, mushrooms, and onions.
3. Sauté onions and mushrooms in oil.
4. Add cabbage; sauté 15 mins until soft.
5. Mix in buckwheat, beans, and passata.
6. Season with marjoram and simmer for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Pearl Barley Stew
recipes.ingredients:
400g pearl barley
3 cans chickpeas
2 bell peppers
2 zucchinis
2 red onions
1 head garlic
2 cans diced tomatoes
Oregano, basil, smoked paprika
recipes.instructions:
1. Boil pearl barley until tender. Drain.
2. Sauté onions and peppers for 10 mins. Add zucchini and garlic for 5 mins.
3. Add tomatoes, chickpeas, and cooked barley.
4. Season and simmer for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Hearty Root Veg & Split Pea Soup
recipes.ingredients:
500g yellow split peas
1.5kg potatoes
1kg carrots
1 celery root
3 onions
Smoked paprika, bay leaves, allspice, marjoram
recipes.instructions:
1. Soak peas for a few hours. Drain.
2. Dice root vegetables.
3. Sauté onions.
4. Add veg, peas, spices, and 2.5L water.
5. Simmer 45-60 mins until peas break down.
6. Stir in paprika and marjoram.

recipes.title: Lean Chicken, Kidney Bean & Corn Chili
recipes.ingredients:
500g chicken breast
3 cans red kidney beans
400g brown rice
2 red peppers
2 onions
2 cans sweet corn
3 cans diced tomatoes
Chili powder, cumin, garlic powder
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook brown rice.
2. Dice chicken small. Brown with onions and peppers.
3. Add cumin and chili powder.
4. Add tomatoes, beans, and corn.
5. Simmer 20-25 mins until thick. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel Avocado Mash
recipes.ingredients:
1 Smoked Mackerel fillet
1 ripe Avocado
1 tbsp Lemon juice
Black pepper
Fresh Dill
recipes.instructions:
1. Flake mackerel.
2. Mash avocado.
3. Mix with lemon and pepper.
4. Serve on keto bread.

recipes.title: Flaxseed & Walnut N'oats
recipes.ingredients:
30g Ground Flaxseed
20g Walnuts
100ml Almond Milk
Cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix flax and milk.
2. Heat until thick.
3. Top with walnuts.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
recipes.ingredients:
200g Firm Tofu
100g Spinach
Turmeric
Nutritional Yeast
recipes.instructions:
1. Crumble tofu.
2. Sauté with spices.
3. Wilt in spinach.
